note: Twelve families and 120 distinct named curated seed mechanisms; combinations beyond this are candidate design space, not 120 historical verified contests.

families.label: Controlled combat & honor
phase_method: Recognize distance, stance, lawful grappling and controlled impact
The opponent counters a change in balance, grip or defended space
A referee records the final lawful pin, strike or boundary capture

families.label: Precision & archery
phase_method: Establish separated safe firing stations and visible target rules
Adjust range, elevation, wind or protected target motion while the rival responds
Officials lock the final target result behind a cleared backstop

families.label: Racing & riding
phase_method: Inspect equal equipment and declare a neutral start and route
One racer changes approach through a defended turn or checkpoint
The last protected crossing is recorded under the declared course rules

families.label: Ball & field sport
phase_method: Introduce the sport, scoring objective and two opponent strategies
Counter-formation and field control shift across a new scoring period
A witnessed final goal, roll, possession or mark resolves the trial

families.label: Tactical war game
phase_method: Give equal maps, simulated units and nonlethal engagement rules
Opponents move to contest a changing marker, strongpoint or supply line
An arbiter certifies the final controlled objective without harming spectators

families.label: Cards & boards
phase_method: Announce sealed cards or board rules and reveal the first legal move
The second round exposes an opponent bluff, sacrifice or strategic trap
The final hand, piece, wager or lock becomes publicly intelligible

families.label: Construction & siege craft
phase_method: Both sides receive equal tools, load limits and safe build space
A trial load or challenge changes the design problem and the counterstrategy
Inspect the final tested structure, device or repaired mechanism

families.label: Height & traversal
phase_method: Inspect anchors, harnesses and safe twin approach lines
Competing route choices change the climb, obstacle or line-of-sight balance
Verify the final protected marker and exit without spectator exposure

families.label: Water and harbor trials
phase_method: Inspect controlled water depth, rescue facilities and neutral flotation gear
Two contenders adapt their course or craft at a defended water checkpoint
Certify the final buoy, dock, or raised marker after safety clearance

families.label: Strength & endurance
phase_method: Define equal loads, time limits and voluntary health exits
Both sides manage fatigue and choose a strategic pacing adjustment
The final measured effort ends the trial without implying fatal consequences

families.label: Logic & escape
phase_method: Open two identical evidence packets and announce the limits of knowledge
A new clue undermines an opponent theory while both attempt a revision
An official tests the final unlocked mechanism or verified solution

families.label: Combined championship trials
phase_method: Commit to a composite objective whose sub-stages share one final outcome
Switch discipline while preserving the previously earned physical position
Finish with a decisive combined station and verified survivor
